integrity: The displayed constant and asymptotics follow from the analytic proof; finite checks are supplementary, not an infinite certification. No independent audit or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The optimal boundary constant is a convergent scalar variational maximum; its unique maximizer and elementary closed form are not established. The supporting 2022 two-Bernstein-combination article was not available in full text; unindexed prior evaluations remain possible.
title: Boundary-layer dominance in the norm of Richardson-extrapolated Bernstein operators
